description: Add items to, remove items from, or tick items on the user's grocery list by hand (at most 100 items; an item already on the list isn't added twice, but one there only for a meal becomes wanted by hand too). Give an amount for each item so it's costed right. Use item ids from get_list. `clear: "checked"` removes ticked items after a shop; `clear: "all"` empties the list and its meals. For a meal's ingredients use update_meals instead, so they stay linked. Returns the list like get_list. After a shop, offer to record what was bought with record_purchases.

quantity.description: Or free text: "2 kg", "a dozen", "2 x 227 g".

unit.description: kg, g, lb, oz, L, mL, cup, tbsp, tsp, each, dozen, can, bunch…

maxStores.description: Shop at most this many stores (remembered; null clears it). The list is split across the set that prices the most items for the least.

near.description: Where to price the list. Remembered for next time; omit to use the last place.

preferBanners.description: Only these banners, e.g. ["no-frills", "food-basics"] (remembered; null clears it).

name: update_list
title: Change the grocery list
